instruction: I want to change the color theme to Dark+ in VS Code, please help modify the setting.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to change the color theme to Default Dark+. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the setting is correctly applied in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves VS Code settings.json from the standard Linux location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly validates JSON key-value pairs by loading the file and comparing expected settings
Expected value {"workbench.colorTheme": "Default Dark+"} is semantically correct for VS Code color theme setting
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement specified in the instruction (changing theme to Dark+)
No postconfig needed: settings.json is persistent on disk after modification
Error handling: metric returns 0.0 if file cannot be read or parsed, preventing false positives

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
